name: arena_fight
goal: Fight through an arena wave. Keep moving, attack when an enemy is in range, heal when health drops. Never open a menu, never quit, never confirm anything.
_comment_policy: Games are the case where an allowlist beats a denylist. This policy names the exact keys the game uses; every other key is not merely refused, it is absent from the actuator's grammar and cannot be generated. Note there is no 'esc' - the actuator physically cannot open the pause menu.
_comment_perception: Perception is deliberately starved. A 3B VLM at 300ms cannot keep up with combat, so the vision model runs only every 4th cycle to answer slow questions ('is a boss on screen', 'did a loot window open'), and the fast loop is driven entirely by probes and reflexes.
_comment_probes: Probes read the HUD directly. Each costs microseconds, so they can drive reflexes at full loop rate with no model involved. Coordinates are for a 1920x1080 layout - use voltage_capture to find the real ones for your game.

engage.brief: Fight. Strafe while attacking. Keep the enemy in front of you.
engage.hint: Chain movement and attacks into one burst - hold a direction, attack twice, release. Do not emit single keypresses.
engage._comment_reflex: Reflexes fire between actuator decisions with no model in the path. 'heal' beats 'dodge' on priority, and both are exclusive so they suppress the actuator for that cycle.

retreat.brief: Back away from the fight and heal. Do not attack.
retreat.hint: Hold S to move backwards. Press Q to heal when it is off cooldown.

boss_fight.brief: Fight the boss. Attack in short bursts, then reposition.
boss_fight.hint: Do not stand still. Every attack burst should end with movement.

collect.brief: Pick up the loot, then close the window.

notes: Set dry_run to false only after checking voltage_journal shows sensible bursts. Probe coordinates are display-specific: run voltage_capture, find your health bar, and edit the regions. The user can stop this at any moment by touching the real mouse or keyboard.
